name: War Domain

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: A battle priest: extra weapon attacks from War Priest, +10 to a missed attack, and free Spiritual Weapon.

feature.name: Guided Strike
feature.summary: Channel Divinity: add +10 to a missed attack roll by you or a creature within 30 feet.
feature.text: When you or a creature within 30 feet misses with an attack roll, you can spend a Channel Divinity use to give that roll a +10 bonus, possibly making it hit (a Reaction if it's someone else's attack).

feature.name: War Domain Spells
feature.summary: Always prepared: Guiding Bolt, Magic Weapon, Shield of Faith, Spiritual Weapon; more at 5, 7 and 9.

feature.name: War Priest
feature.summary: Bonus Action weapon or Unarmed Strike attack; uses = Wis modifier per Short or Long Rest.
feature.text: As a Bonus Action you can make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once), regaining all uses on a Short or Long Rest.

feature.name: War God's Blessing
feature.summary: Channel Divinity: cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a slot or Concentration (1 minute).

feature.name: Avatar of Battle
feature.summary: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage.
